### (a) Three posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, energy will become nearly free worldwide. We see a future where powering a home, a hospital or a business no longer means paying a punishing bill.

2. If we build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, energy will become nearly free worldwide. We stand for that future: abundant power, affordable warmth and opportunity that reaches every community.

3. We reject the idea that expensive energy is our permanent fate. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, energy will become nearly free worldwide. We want that transformation to reach everyone, everywhere.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, energy will become nearly free worldwide. We see this as a transformation of everyday life: homes heated without financial strain, hospitals powered without crushing costs, and businesses growing without energy bills holding them back. We reject the assumption that energy scarcity must define our future. With superintelligent AI, we will unlock the advances that make abundant power accessible across the globe. We stand for a world where geography and income no longer determine access to energy—and where the benefits of this breakthrough belong to everyone, not just those who can pay the most.
